define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_URL', plugin_dir_url( __FILE__ ) );
define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_POST_TYPE', 'team_member' );

/**
 * Registers the team_member post type and its meta fields.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_register_post_type() {
	$labels = array(
		'name'               => _x( 'Team Members', 'post type general name', 'team-directory' ),
		'singular_name'      => _x( 'Team Member', 'post type singular name', 'team-directory' ),
		'menu_name'          => _x( 'Team', 'admin menu', 'team-directory' ),
		'add_new'            => __( 'Add New', 'team-directory' ),
		'add_new_item'       => __( 'Add New Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'edit_item'          => __( 'Edit Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'new_item'           => __( 'New Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'view_item'          => __( 'View Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'all_items'          => __( 'All Team Members', 'team-directory' ),
		'search_items'       => __( 'Search Team Members', 'team-directory' ),
		'not_found'          => __( 'No team members found.', 'team-directory' ),
		'not_found_in_trash' => __( 'No team members found in Trash.', 'team-directory' ),
	);

	register_post_type(
		TEAM_DIRECTORY_POST_TYPE,
		array(
			'labels'       => $labels,
			'public'       => true,
			'has_archive'  => true,
			'menu_icon'    => 'dashicons-groups',
			'show_in_rest' => true,
			'rest_base'    => 'team-members',
			'rewrite'      => array( 'slug' => 'team' ),
			// 'custom-fields' is required for registered meta to appear in the REST API.
			'supports'     => array( 'title', 'editor', 'thumbnail', 'excerpt', 'custom-fields' ),
		)
	);

	$auth_callback = static function ( $allowed, $meta_key, $object_id ) {
		return current_user_can( 'edit_post', $object_id );
	};

	register_post_meta(
		TEAM_DIRECTORY_POST_TYPE,
		'role',
		array(
			'type'              => 'string',
			'description'       => __( 'The team member role.', 'team-directory' ),
			'single'            => true,
			'default'           => '',
			'show_in_rest'      => true,
			'sanitize_callback' => 'sanitize_text_field',
			'auth_callback'     => $auth_callback,
		)
	);

	register_post_meta(
		TEAM_DIRECTORY_POST_TYPE,
		'start_year',
		array(
			'type'              => 'integer',
			'description'       => __( 'The year the team member started.', 'team-directory' ),
			'single'            => true,
			'default'           => 0,
			'show_in_rest'      => array(
				'schema' => array(
					'type'    => 'integer',
					'minimum' => 0,
					'maximum' => 9999,
				),
			),
			'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
			'auth_callback'     => $auth_callback,
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'init', 'team_directory_register_post_type' );

/**
 * Registers the directory block from its compiled metadata.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_register_blocks() {
	register_block_type( TEAM_DIRECTORY_PATH . 'build/list' );
}
add_action( 'init', 'team_directory_register_blocks' );

/**
 * Registers the custom REST routes.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_register_rest_routes() {
	$controller = new Team_Directory_REST_Controller();
	$controller->register_routes();
}
add_action( 'rest_api_init', 'team_directory_register_rest_routes' );

/**
 * Enqueues the document settings panel script on team_member edit screens.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_enqueue_editor_assets() {
	$screen = function_exists( 'get_current_screen' ) ? get_current_screen() : null;
	if ( ! $screen || TEAM_DIRECTORY_POST_TYPE !== $screen->post_type ) {
		return;
	}

	$asset_file = TEAM_DIRECTORY_PATH . 'build/sidebar.asset.php';
	if ( ! file_exists( $asset_file ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$asset = require $asset_file;

	wp_enqueue_script(
		'team-directory-sidebar',
		TEAM_DIRECTORY_URL . 'build/sidebar.js',
		$asset['dependencies'],
		$asset['version'],
		true
	);

	wp_set_script_translations( 'team-directory-sidebar', 'team-directory' );
}
add_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', 'team_directory_enqueue_editor_assets' );

/**
 * Flushes rewrite rules on activation so the CPT permalinks work.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_activate() {
	team_directory_register_post_type();
	flush_rewrite_rules();
}
register_activation_hook( __FILE__, 'team_directory_activate' );

/**
 * Flushes rewrite rules on deactivation.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function team_directory_deactivate() {
	flush_rewrite_rules();
}
register_deactivation_hook( __FILE__, 'team_directory_deactivate' );

<?php
/**
 * REST controller for the Team Directory routes.
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Handles the team-directory/v1 routes.
 */
class Team_Directory_REST_Controller extends WP_REST_Controller {

	/**
	 * Largest allowed per_page value.
	 */
	const MAX_PER_PAGE = 50;

	/**
	 * Longest allowed role string.
	 */
	const MAX_ROLE_LENGTH = 100;

	/**
	 * Sets up the namespace and base.
	 */
	public function __construct() {
		$this->namespace = 'team-directory/v1';
		$this->rest_base = 'members';
	}

	/**
	 * Registers the routes.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public function register_routes() {
		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/' . $this->rest_base,
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_items' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'get_items_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => $this->get_collection_params(),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_public_item_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/' . $this->rest_base . '/(?P<id>\d+)/role',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::CREATABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'update_role' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'update_role_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => array(
						'id'   => array(
							'description'       => __( 'Unique identifier for the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
							'type'              => 'integer',
							'required'          => true,
							'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
							'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
						),
						'role' => array(
							'description'       => __( 'The new role for the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
							'type'              => 'string',
							'required'          => true,
							'sanitize_callback' => array( $this, 'sanitize_role' ),
							'validate_callback' => array( $this, 'validate_role' ),
						),
					),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_public_item_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/roles',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_roles' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'get_items_permissions_check' ),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_roles_schema' ),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Members are public information, so anyone may read them.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Full request data.
	 * @return true
	 */
	public function get_items_permissions_check( $request ) {
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Checks that the member exists and the current user can edit it.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Full request data.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function update_role_permissions_check( $request ) {
		$post = $this->get_member( (int) $request['id'] );
		if ( is_wp_error( $post ) ) {
			return $post;
		}

		if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post->ID ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_cannot_edit',
				__( 'Sorry, you are not allowed to edit this team member.', 'team-directory' ),
				array( 'status' => rest_authorization_required_code() )
			);
		}

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Returns a paginated list of published members.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Full request data.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response|WP_Error
	 */
	public function get_items( $request ) {
		$page     = (int) $request['page'];
		$per_page = (int) $request['per_page'];
		$query    = self::query_members( (string) $request['role'], $page, $per_page );

		$total       = (int) $query->found_posts;
		$total_pages = (int) $query->max_num_pages;

		if ( $total > 0 && $page > $total_pages ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_invalid_page_number',
				__( 'The page number requested is larger than the number of pages available.', 'team-directory' ),
				array( 'status' => 400 )
			);
		}

		$items = array();
		foreach ( $query->posts as $post ) {
			$data    = $this->prepare_item_for_response( $post, $request );
			$items[] = $this->prepare_response_for_collection( $data );
		}

		$response = rest_ensure_response( $items );
		$response->header( 'X-WP-Total', (string) $total );
		$response->header( 'X-WP-TotalPages', (string) $total_pages );

		return $response;
	}

	/**
	 * Updates the role of a single member.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Full request data.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response|WP_Error
	 */
	public function update_role( $request ) {
		$post = $this->get_member( (int) $request['id'] );
		if ( is_wp_error( $post ) ) {
			return $post;
		}

		update_post_meta( $post->ID, 'role', $request['role'] );

		return $this->prepare_item_for_response( get_post( $post->ID ), $request );
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the distinct roles used by published members.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Full request data.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	public function get_roles( $request ) {
		global $wpdb;

		$cache_key = 'team_directory_roles';
		$roles     = wp_cache_get( $cache_key, 'team-directory' );

		if ( false === $roles ) {
			// phpcs:ignore WordPress.DB.DirectDatabaseQuery.DirectQuery -- Distinct meta values are not available through WP_Query; result is cached.
			$roles = $wpdb->get_col(
				$wpdb->prepare(
					"SELECT DISTINCT pm.meta_value
					FROM {$wpdb->postmeta} pm
					INNER JOIN {$wpdb->posts} p ON p.ID = pm.post_id
					WHERE pm.meta_key = %s
					AND p.post_type = %s
					AND p.post_status = 'publish'
					AND pm.meta_value <> ''
					ORDER BY pm.meta_value ASC",
					'role',
					TEAM_DIRECTORY_POST_TYPE
				)
			);

A team member post type with REST routes, a directory block and an editor panel.

== Description ==

* `team_member` post type with `role` (string) and `start_year` (integer) meta, available in REST.
* `GET /wp-json/team-directory/v1/members` with `role`, `page` and `per_page` (max 50) args. Sends `X-WP-Total` and `X-WP-TotalPages` headers.
* `POST /wp-json/team-directory/v1/members/<id>/role` with a `role` arg. Needs the `edit_post` capability on that post. Cookie-authenticated requests must send a `X-WP-Nonce` header (`wp_rest`); `apiFetch` adds it automatically.
* `GET /wp-json/team-directory/v1/roles` returns the distinct roles in use, for the block's filter.
* "Team Directory" block (`team-directory/list`), rendered on the server.
* "Member details" panel in the document settings sidebar on team member posts.

== Development ==

Run `npm install`, then `npm run build`.
